title: Human confirmation policy v1
description: Optional file .loop/control/policy.json. It says how the human decisions accept, authorize and promote may be given in this project. It is written by hand; no operation, and in particular no chat tool call, ever writes it.

human_confirmation.description: tty-or-local-page: a word typed at an interactive terminal, or a word typed on the local confirmation page. tty-only: the terminal and nothing else; chat tool calls and --input are refused with CONFIRMATION_TTY_ONLY.

control_page_autostart.description: Whether the loop starts the long-lived control page by itself when it is not running (on every tick, every state-changing operation, the dashboard and the chat connection). Absent: true when confirmation_page is set, false otherwise.

confirmation_page.description: Where the confirmation page and the setup approval page listen, so they can be opened from a phone inside a private network or VPN. Absent: 127.0.0.1, a random port, a localhost link. Plain HTTP: never expose it on a public interface. A listen address that is not loopback (127.0.0.0/8 or ::1) requires advertise.

listen.description: IP literal the servers bind to, for example 127.0.0.1, 0.0.0.0 or 192.0.2.10. Never a host name.

advertise.description: Host name or IP the link names and the Origin check accepts, without a scheme or a port. Defaults to listen when listen is loopback.

port.description: Fixed port. Omit it for a random port. With a fixed port only one page can be open at a time.
